spans.s: (w.r. Sāh.; Uttarar.) or मौग्ध्य (ib.; Kathās. &c.), n. (fr. मुग्ध), simplicity, innocence, inexperience, a feminine grace (asking a lover to tell what is already known); charm, beauty, MW.
